name: Unnamed planeswalker of the Ozolith
description: A meddling planeswalker who manipulated Ikoria through the Ozolith and warned Lukka of its consequences; only his voice appears.

description_citations.text: "Lukka". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Ozolith explodes when Lukka ignores the unknown planeswalker's warning, igniting his spark as he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Lukka refused to listen and the Ozolith exploded, causing his planeswalker's spark to ignite as he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
